voice.summary: Sounds like a sensible bookkeeper: brisk, exact and never condescending about money. Labels are standard invoice words, and totals are always shown with currency and tax so nothing is a surprise.
dos: Use standard invoice terms like subtotal, tax and due date
Always show currency and tax rate with totals
Confirm changes immediately in the preview
donts: Do not use accounting jargon without a label
Do not hide discounts or fees
Do not add cute copy to money

taglines: Type it once, print it right
boilerplate: Billwright is a split-screen invoice builder that lets freelancers and small businesses edit line items, tax and discounts and see a print-ready invoice update as they type.

microcopy.success: Invoice ready. Save it as a PDF.
microcopy.error: Check the highlighted amounts. They need to be numbers.
microcopy.empty: No line items yet. Add your first item.

logo.note: Stacked coins say money and billing in one quick glance.
